uncited: *   **Splat Graph:** An implicit or explicit graph where nodes are Gaussian kernels and edges connect adjacent kernels based on spatial proximity or splat overlap.
For each triangle vertex $t_{i,k}$, identify a set of adjacent Gaussians $M(t_{i,k})$ from the splat graph.
The deformation map $\phi_\Delta$ is defined only on the Gaussian means.
*   **No Adjacent Neighbors:** If a vertex has no adjacent Gaussians in the splat graph, the displacement cannot be computed via weighting.
